s24.title: Data cleanup
s24.explain: Federal rules require you to securely dispose of screening information once you no longer need it.

about.title: About
about.licensesIntro: Evenlease is built with these open-source packages. Thank you to their authors.

s26.title: Legal & privacy
s26.notLawFirm: Evenlease is a checklist tool, not a law firm. It does not give legal advice, and using it does not make your decisions lawful. Laws vary by state and city — check the rules where your rental is, or talk to a lawyer.
s26.sameCriteria: Evenlease helps you apply the same criteria to everyone and keep a record of why you decided.
s26.data: Your data stays on this phone and in backups you create. We have no servers and collect nothing: no account, no ads, no tracking.
s26.applicantData: Evenlease never asks for Social Security numbers or dates of birth. Delete applicants' data once you no longer need it (Settings › Data cleanup).

s27.title: Delete all data
s27.explain: This deletes every rental, applicant, document, letter, setting and backup password on this phone. Backup files you saved elsewhere are not touched.
